translations.idiomatic: Kaifeng Prefecture: strategically important, busy, taxing, and difficult to administer.

translations.idiomatic: In the early Qing it served as the capital of Henan Province and still administered four departments and thirty counties.

translations.idiomatic: The Jialu River enters the prefecture, passes through Zhuxian Town into Weishi County; it is the old Cai canal, whose upper course is also known as the Sha River.

translations.idiomatic: The Commentary on the Water Classic identifies the Qu River with the Hong Canal, but the Jun River has long been silted up.

translations.idiomatic: It received the Yanjia River on the left, passed the old city of Xiyang in Huangchuan, south of the city became the Guandu River, passed Tianci Mountain — the Pi River of the Commentary on the Water Classic.

translations.literal: Farther east the Shuanglun River all follow it.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east the Shuanglun River all followed it.

translations.literal: Two towns: Zhongdu and Niushan.
translations.idiomatic: Two towns: Zhongdu and Niushan.

translations.literal: One Changtan post station.
translations.idiomatic: One Changtan post station.

translations.literal: Gushi: busy, taxing, and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Gushi County: busy, taxing, and difficult to administer.

translations.literal: Forty li east of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It lay forty li east of the prefecture.

translations.literal: To the east: Dashan.
translations.idiomatic: To the east lay Dashan.

translations.literal: To the south: Dushan, Muzei, and Qingfeng Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: To the south lay Dushan, Muzei, and Qingfeng Ridge.

sentences.zh: 西北：淮水自息入，逕棗林岡、安寧、期思。

translations.literal: To the northwest: the Huai River enters from Xi, passes Zaolingang, Anning, and Qisi.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest, the Huai River entered from Xi, passed Zaolingang, Anning, and Qisi.

sentences.zh: 古蔣國，亦浸丘故城，其左岸會汝水，至硃皋鎮，納白鷺及春河。

translations.literal: The ancient state of Jiang, also the old city of Jinqiu; on its left bank it meets the Ru River, reaches Zhugao Market, and receives the Bailu and Chun rivers.
translations.idiomatic: At the ancient state of Jiang, also the old city of Jinqiu, on its left bank it met the Ru River, reached Zhugao Market, and received the Bailu and Chun rivers.

translations.literal: Farther east, Wangliuji, where a patrol office was stationed.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east, at Wangliuji a patrol office maintained a post.

sentences.zh: 至三河尖，決水、灌水入焉。

translations.literal: Reaching Sanhejian, the Jue and Guan rivers enter there.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Sanhejian, the Jue and Guan rivers entered there.

sentences.zh: 決自商城入，為史河，左合長江河，右歧為泉河，古陽泉水水經注，自雩婁東北逕雞備亭，過安豐故城，邊城郡治。

translations.literal: The Jue enters from Shangcheng as the Shi River, receives the Changjiang River on the left, branches right as the Quan River — the ancient Yangquan River of the Commentary on the Water Classic, from Yulou northeast passes Jibeiting, passes the old city of Anfeng, seat of Biancheng Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: The Jue entered from Shangcheng as the Shi River, received the Changjiang River on the left, branched right as the Quan River — the ancient Yangquan River of the Commentary on the Water Classic, from Yulou northeast passed Jibeiting, passed the old city of Anfeng, seat of Biancheng Commandery.

translations.literal: It again passes Rupo Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: It again passed Rupo Marsh.

translations.literal: The marsh is today Longtankou.
translations.idiomatic: The marsh is today Longtankou.

sentences.zh: 右歧為清河，合勝湖，又西北逕史家故城，左納羊行河、急流澗，逕城東而北，古蓼國在焉。

translations.literal: It branches right as the Qing River, joins Sheng Lake, then northwest passes the old city of Shijia, receives the Yangxing River and Jiliu Stream on the left, passes east of the city and north — the ancient state of Liao was there.
translations.idiomatic: It branched right as the Qing River, joined Sheng Lake, then northwest passed the old city of Shijia, received the Yangxing River and Jiliu Stream on the left, passed east of the city and north — the ancient state of Liao lay there.

translations.literal: The Guan enters from Shangcheng as the Qu River.
translations.idiomatic: The Guan entered from Shangcheng as the Qu River.

sentences.zh: 淮南子「孫叔敖決期思之水，以灌雩婁之野」。

translations.literal: The Huainanzi: "Sun Shu'ao diverted the waters of Qisi to irrigate the fields of Yulou."
translations.idiomatic: The Huainanzi records that "Sun Shu'ao diverted the waters of Qisi to irrigate the fields of Yulou."

sentences.zh: 又西北，逕蓼潭，至城北來會，為兩河口。

translations.literal: Farther northwest, it passes Liaotan, reaches north of the city to join, forming Lianghekou.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northwest, it passed Liaotan, reached north of the city to join, forming Lianghekou.

translations.literal: The Eastern Wei prefecture of Huai was there.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Wei prefecture of Huai lay there.

sentences.zh: 又東北，右歧為堪河，迤為七里岡，復與清泉二支津合。

translations.literal: Farther northeast, it branches right as the Kan River, winds as Qiligang, and again joins the two branch channels of Qingquan.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northeast, it branched right as the Kan River, wound as Qiligang, and again joined the two branch channels of Qingquan.

translations.literal: Farther north it enters the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Farther north it entered the Huai.

translations.literal: The Huai River again east enters Huoqiu.
translations.idiomatic: The Huai River again east entered Huoqiu.

translations.literal: Two towns: Zhugao and Qisi.
translations.idiomatic: Two towns: Zhugao and Qisi.

translations.literal: One county post station.
translations.idiomatic: One county post station.

translations.literal: Xi: busy, taxing, and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Xi County: busy, taxing, and difficult to administer.

translations.literal: Ninety li northwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It lay ninety li northwest of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 西有淮水自羅山入，又東逕白公城，至城南。

translations.literal: To the west the Huai River enters from Luoshan, then east passes Baigong City to south of the city.
translations.idiomatic: To the west the Huai River entered from Luoshan, then east passed Baigong City to south of the city.

translations.literal: Farther east, the old city of Xinxin.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east lay the old city of Xinxin.

sentences.zh: 分流，左納清水港，合泥河，復合閭河，自正陽入，蓋慎水故瀆，逕褒信長陵故城注之。

translations.literal: It divides; receives Qingshui Harbor on the left, joins the Ni River, again joins the Lü River entering from Zhengyang — the old channel of the Shen River — passes the old cities of Baoxin and Changling to feed it.
translations.idiomatic: It divided; received Qingshui Harbor on the left, joined the Ni River, again joined the Lü River entering from Zhengyang — the old channel of the Shen River — passed the old cities of Baoxin and Changling to feed it.

translations.literal: The Shenpo River of the Commentary on the Water Classic.
translations.idiomatic: It was the Shenpo River of the Commentary on the Water Classic.

translations.literal: Farther east it passes Wulongji and enters the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east it passed Wulongji and entered the prefecture.

translations.literal: Its Bailu River enters and passes Qisiji.
translations.idiomatic: Its Bailu River entered and passed Qisiji.

sentences.zh: 西北：汝水自汝陽入，入新蔡，復緣安徽阜陽界逕固城汛，並達之玉梁渠。

translations.literal: To the northwest: the Ru River enters from Ruyang, enters Xincai, again follows the Fuyang border in Anhui past Gucheng Station, and all reach the Yuliang Canal.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest, the Ru River entered from Ruyang, entered Xincai, again followed the Fuyang border in Anhui past Gucheng Station, and all reached the Yuliang Canal.

translations.literal: One town: Yangzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: One town: Yangzhuang.

translations.literal: One county post station.
translations.idiomatic: One county post station.

translations.literal: Shangcheng: difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Shangcheng County: difficult to administer.

translations.literal: One hundred twenty li southeast of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred twenty li southeast of the prefecture.

translations.literal: To the southeast: Dasu Mountain, the ancient Dabie.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast lay Dasu Mountain, the ancient Dabie.

translations.literal: To the south: Huayang and Matou.
translations.idiomatic: To the south lay Huayang and Matou.

translations.literal: To the northeast: Qingshan.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast lay Qingshan.

translations.literal: To the southwest: Niushan, where the Jue River issues forth.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest lay Niushan, where the Jue River issued forth.

sentences.zh: 水經注「出廬江雩婁縣南大別山」。

translations.literal: The Commentary on the Water Classic: "issues from Dabie Mountain south of Yulou County in Lujiang."
translations.idiomatic: The Commentary on the Water Classic records that it "issued from Dabie Mountain south of Yulou County in Lujiang."

sentences.zh: 東合八仙台、黃昏山五關水。

translations.literal: East it joins the Wuguan River of Baxiantai and Huanghunshan.
translations.idiomatic: East it joined the Wuguan River of Baxiantai and Huanghunshan.

sentences.zh: 又東北曰寨河，左合麻河，逕金家寨，其西北則長江、石槽、沙河。

translations.literal: Farther northeast it is called the Zhai River, receives the Ma River on the left, passes Jinjiazhai; to its northwest are the Changjiang, Shicao, and Sha rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northeast it was called the Zhai River, received the Ma River on the left, passed Jinjiazhai; to its northwest lay the Changjiang, Shicao, and Sha rivers.

sentences.zh: 西南：黃柏，灌水出，北合木廠、盛家店、九水河，逕城西，亦曰龍潭河，併入固始。

translations.literal: To the southwest: Huangbai, where the Guan River issues forth, north joins Mucang, Shengjiadian, and the Jiushui River, passes west of the city, also called the Longtan River, and merges into Gushi.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest lay Huangbai, where the Guan River issued forth, north joined Mucang, Shengjiadian, and the Jiushui River, passed west of the city, also called the Longtan River, and merged into Gushi County.

translations.literal: To the northwest: Xiongshan, where the Chun River issues forth.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest lay Xiongshan, where the Chun River issued forth.

translations.literal: The Zhaoyu River of the Water Classic.
translations.idiomatic: It was the Zhaoyu River of the Water Classic.

translations.literal: It also follows the Gushi border into the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It also followed the Gushi border into the prefecture.

translations.literal: Niushifan patrol office.
translations.idiomatic: A patrol office was maintained at Niushifan.

translations.literal: One county post station.
translations.idiomatic: One county post station.

translations.literal: Xichuan Directly Administered Subprefecture: busy and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Xichuan Directly Administered Subprefecture: busy and difficult to administer.

translations.literal: In the Ming it was re-established by carving out territory from Neixiang as a county.
translations.idiomatic: In the Ming it was re-established by carving out territory from Neixiang as a county.

translations.literal: In Daoguang 12 it became a subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 12 it became a subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年升，改南汝光道為南汝光淅道。

translations.literal: In Xuantong 1 it was elevated, and the Nanruguang Circuit was renamed the Nanruguangxi Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 it was elevated, and the Nanruguang Circuit was renamed the Nanruguangxi Circuit.

translations.literal: To the west: Hushan.
translations.idiomatic: To the west lay Hushan.

translations.literal: To the northwest: Huangsuo Village.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest lay Huangsuo Village.

sentences.zh: 丹水自陝西商南緣界逕荊子關，其北葛花山，其南丹崖。

translations.literal: The Dan River from Shangnan in Shaanxi follows the border past Jingziguan; to its north Gehuashan, to its south Danya.
translations.idiomatic: The Dan River from Shangnan in Shaanxi followed the border past Jingziguan; to its north lay Gehuashan, to its south Danya.

sentences.zh: 又東南，逕凌老龍山，其黑漆河入為淇河，逕花園關、岞客、獨阜山注之。

translations.literal: Farther southeast, it passes Linglaolongshan; its Heiqi River enters as the Qi River, passes Huayuanguan, Zuoke, and Dufushan to feed it.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southeast, it passed Linglaolongshan; its Heiqi River entered as the Qi River, passed Huayuanguan, Zuoke, and Dufushan to feed it.

sentences.zh: 至城西南納滔河，逕石杯、雷山至於村保，古商於三戶城在焉。

translations.literal: Reaching southwest of the city it receives the Tao River, passes Shibei and Leishan to Cunbao — the ancient Shangyu city of Sanhu was there.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching southwest of the city it received the Tao River, passed Shibei and Leishan to Cunbao — the ancient Shangyu city of Sanhu lay there.

translations.literal: It meets the Xi River on the left.
translations.idiomatic: It met the Xi River on the left.

sentences.zh: 又東南逕太白、玉照山，緣內鄉界入湖北均州。

translations.literal: Farther southeast it passes Taibai and Yuzhaoshan, follows the Neixiang border and enters Junzhou in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southeast it passed Taibai and Yuzhaoshan, followed the Neixiang border, and entered Junzhou in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 水經注「丹水自三戶城逕丹水故城南、南鄉縣北，右合汋水」。

translations.literal: The Commentary on the Water Classic: "the Dan River from Sanhu City passes south of the old city of Danshui and north of Nanxiang County, receiving the Zhuo River on the right."
translations.idiomatic: The Commentary on the Water Classic records that "the Dan River from Sanhu City passed south of the old city of Danshui and north of Nanxiang County, receiving the Zhuo River on the right."

translations.literal: Zhuo is Jun — a graphic error.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuo is Jun — a graphic error.

translations.literal: Jingziguan, where the assistant magistrate was stationed.
translations.idiomatic: At Jingziguan the assistant magistrate maintained a post.

translations.literal: One town: Xiakou.
translations.idiomatic: One town: Xiakou.

translations.literal: One subprefectural post station.
translations.idiomatic: One subprefectural post station.
